name: Mboni eye
rule: Every state is the same canonical eye (same paths, same proportions). Only eyelids, iris, pupil and highlights move. Never add anything else.

cssVariables.--mboni-dur: animation length of the state (each state has its own default)
cssVariables.--mboni-count: iteration count (infinite for loops, 1 for activate)
cssVariables.--mboni-enter: ramp-in length for processing (0.6s) and attentive (0.7s)

attributes.data-motion: auto | off (off = static logo; prefers-reduced-motion does this automatically)

static.useWhen: Idle / resting. Default state. Also the logo everywhere else.

thinking.useWhen: A user message was just received and Mboni is working out what to do, before searching or computing.

scanning.useWhen: Looking through data: searching datasets, reading tables or documents, retrieving sources.

activate.useWhen: Mboni wakes up: assistant opens, page loads, session starts. Then return to static.

processing.useWhen: Heavy lifting: calculating, aggregating, analysing, building the answer.

attentive.useWhen: Presenting the answer. Hold while the user reads, then return to static after ~8s of no input.
